hooks.name: branchyard-session-start
hooks.command: command -v by >/dev/null 2>&1 && by hook --harness gemini-cli session-start || true
hooks.description: What changed in this repository's Branchyard branches

hooks.name: branchyard-before-agent
hooks.command: command -v by >/dev/null 2>&1 && by hook --harness gemini-cli user-prompt-submit || true
hooks.description: Branchyard branches that finished, failed, are blocked or ask since the last prompt
